decisions.statement: This module has the union of every address kind.
A kind left out of the union does not compile.
Where the index files an address is asked of the kind that address is.
An address names the property a value is read by.
No address names a page by a value alone.
A slug names pages of many types.
An address is named here as well as read here.
An address named with a scope reads back as the scoped kind.
Which scope a page carries is answered by whoever names that page's address.

definition: what form a relation value takes when it names a page
